scripts.test:api: npm run allure:clean && allure run -- playwright test --project=api
scripts.test:ui: npm run allure:clean && allure run -- playwright test --project=chromium
scripts.test:playwright: npm run allure:clean && allure run -- playwright test
scripts.allure:clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rm } from 'node:fs/promises'; await rm('allure/results', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:playwright
